def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==2]
    from collections import Counter
    rowc=Counter(i for i,j in pts)
    spine=[r for r,n in rowc.items() if n>=2]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    if spine:
        r=spine[0]
        cs=[j for i,j in pts if i==r]
        for j in range(min(cs)+1,max(cs)):
            if out[r][j]==0: out[r][j]=3
        for j in set(j for i,j in pts):
            col=[i for i,c in pts if c==j]
            lo,hi=min(min(col),r),max(max(col),r)
            for i in range(lo,hi+1):
                if out[i][j]==0: out[i][j]=3
    return out
